pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/LabSearch.tsx:194 The /layout shell is a desktop authoring composer driven by keyboard shortcuts and mouse clicks, not a landscape phone game controller. I searched all 18 context files and the whole src/components/layout-lab/ directory for setPointerCapture, onPointerDown, pointerId, throttle, handedness, joystick and touchstart and got zero hits, so none of the subject's controls (steering pad, go/fire/brake holds, per-touch ownership, layout or handedness choice) exist here.
